reason: The independently implemented exact-MaxWeight canonical tie MILP can be falsely reported infeasible by HiGHS presolve when its fixed primary-objective row is linearly dependent on the queue constraints. This occurs on a supported nine-action state (R8, Q=(90,31,57)), so v1 must not be executed.
repair: Version 2 disables presolve only for the fixed-primary-objective tie solve; the primary duration-threshold MILPs retain presolve.
